name: KeenKeeper Friend Tracking App
short: A friend-tracking web app with quick check-ins, timeline history, statistics, and responsive UI.
description: KeenKeeper helps users track communication with friends through call, text, and video check-ins. It includes dynamic friend details, localStorage-based timeline history, statistics visualization, and smooth navigation.
challenges: The main challenge was keeping timeline data persistent while maintaining clean route-based navigation and responsive layouts for mobile devices.
improvements: Future improvements include real authentication, cloud database support, reminder notifications, and better analytics for relationship tracking.

name: Class Routine Web App
short: A responsive class routine app with current class display, filters, and clean student-friendly interface.
description: This project presents class schedules in a simple and responsive way. Users can filter routines by day or teacher name and quickly understand upcoming or current classes from a polished UI.
challenges: The challenging part was designing a mobile-first routine layout that stays readable while showing enough schedule information.
improvements: Future plans include admin panel support, editable routines, notification reminders, and automatic current-class detection.

name: Weather App
short: A weather search application that shows city-based weather information with a clean animated interface.
description: The Weather App allows users to search for a city and view important weather information through an attractive responsive design. It focuses on API handling, user input, conditional rendering, and error management.
challenges: The key challenge was handling API errors, empty searches, loading states, and showing data in a user-friendly format.
improvements: Future improvements include location-based weather, hourly forecast, dark/light mode, and better weather animations.
